facts.text: PyRoboSim is a 2D mobile robot simulator for behavior prototyping with an optional ROS 2 interface.
World is the core world modeling class and holds the robots, rooms, hallways, locations, object spawns and objects.
World.reset(deterministic=False, seed=-1) reloads the source YAML file (or the stored source snapshot), marks the world changed and returns True; its docstring says a seed of -1 means no fixed seed.
World.reset treats seed < 0 as no fixed seed and otherwise calls np.random.seed(seed) before the reload.
World.shutdown starts a robot.cancel_actions thread for every robot whose is_busy() is true, joins those threads, then stops every robot's sensor threads.
Robot.is_busy is true only while executing_action, executing_plan or executing_nav is set, whereas is_moving also counts a non-zero dynamics velocity.
RobotDynamics2D.reset keeps the current pose when pose is None and replaces the velocity with the supplied array, whose default is [0.0, 0.0, 0.0].

World.set_inflation_radius stores inflation_radius and updates the collision polygons of every location, room and hallway plus the world polygons; its docstring names meters but states no numeric bound.

World.open_location resolves a string through get_entity_by_name, accepts only a Location or Hallway, reports an already-open entity as SUCCESS, refuses a locked one, and otherwise sets it open recursively, updates polygons and marks the world changed.
World.close_location applies the same name, type and lock checks, refuses to close a hallway that a robot occupies, and otherwise sets the entity closed recursively and marks the world changed.
World.get_locations returns the world's Location list, optionally filtered by category.
World.get_room_names returns the name of every room in self.rooms.
World.get_hallway_names returns the name of every hallway in self.hallways.
World.get_hallway_by_name resolves a stored entity only when it is a Hallway.
World.get_entity_by_name resolves any name through the name_to_entity map.
World.get_object_names returns the object names, optionally filtered by category.
An Entity declares is_open = True and is_locked = False as class attributes.
The world YAML schema documents inflation_radius as the collision padding radius around rooms, hallways and locations and does not give a numeric range.

determinism.notes: The fake has no random generator: it records the reset seed but its placeholder world state does not vary with it. A live run forwards the seed to World.reset.

gaps: the fake is a pure-Python analytic stand-in: it runs no pyrobosim physics, navigation, planning, robot dynamics or ROS node, and never imports or executes the clone
every room, hallway, location, object and robot name, every open state and the inflation radius in the fake are placeholders, not the world YAML or the upstream simulator state

only the world-level reset, location/hallway open and close, inflation-radius configuration and read-only state are served; robot navigation, pick/place, task plans, dynamics stepping, sensors, world-entity editing, rendering and the optional ROS 2 interface are NOT COVERED

World.shutdown only cancels robots whose is_busy() is true; Robot.cancel_actions waits for an in-flight executing_action such as a pick or place to return instead of interrupting it, so the stop is not proof of immediate quiescence for that action

World.shutdown joins its cancel threads without a timeout; when it outlasts the 1 s default e-stop budget the e-stop reports MHS.SAFETY.SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held while the native shutdown continues; the fake's shutdown returns at once
the clone states no numeric bound for the world inflation radius; the driver declares it operator_required and the example overlay is an operator example, not a device bound
World.reset reloads source_yaml_file when it is set and otherwise the in-memory source snapshot; the fake models only a fixed placeholder initial state

operator_required.name: inflation_radius
operator_required.reason: The clone states no numeric range for the world inflation radius; the operator supplies the accepted range before this write is allowed.

safe_state.description: Every robot's dynamics velocity is zeroed, World.shutdown cancels busy simulated robot actions and stops sensor threads (they stay stopped after a safety reset), and the velocities are zeroed again; it does not destroy the world, lock the entities or prevent an external client from issuing new work.
